description.narrative: Association of Farmers and Nature Net (FNN) is a local, non-profit and non-political farmer organization, represents a network of village-based farmer organizations that acts as an umbrella to represent and serve the interests of self-help associations, agricultural cooperatives, and provides technical assistances on capacity building. FNN has joint the FAIR4ALL project is mainly oriented towards the sustainable of rubber and banana value chains and trade for small scale farmers through improving of sustainable inclusive and women-centred business practice at scale; more responsible private and financial sector; and enabling environment for agriculture investment. The project will be located in three provinces such as Kampong Cham, Thbong Khmum and Kampot provinces of Cambodia. The project is mainly oriented towards the sustainable of rubber and banana value chains and trade for small scale farmers through improving of sustainable inclusive and women-centred business practice at scale; more responsible private and financial sector; and enabling environment for agriculture investment. large-scale banana plantations. Importing banana seedlings and planting material from neighbouring countries raises a high risk of introducing invasive species, especially the Foc TR4, which may cause the collapse of the industry. The Foc TR4 causes disease without predisposing factors. If unchecked, Fusarium caused by Foc TR4 can wipe out an entire plantation. The proposed project areas are located in 3 provinces including Kampong Cham, Tbong Khum and Kampot provinces. In those target areas farmers are facing constraints related to lack of capacity to address technical aspects to meet required quality and safety standard by the potential buyers, the inputs cost is still high, lack of entrepreneurship skill, limited of market facilitation and networking for small scale farmers. This issue results in low productivity and profitability.

participating-org.narrative: FNN is village-based associations and networks of farmer (mostly rice farmers). The associations are playing an important role in promoting mutual help, solidarity and cooperation among villagers, as well as coordinating and undertaking collective actionin developing ecological agriculture, natural resources management, cooperative business practices and community development.
